reason: The substitutes part is honestly what I need, but I'd try the free 3 dishes and that's more than I'd actually cook in a month. I save recipe videos I never make, so paying for unlimited dishes I won't use makes no sense.
objection: Even with substitutes, by the time I'm home from work I want dinner in 20 minutes, and I doubt real Thai home-style recipes with swapped ingredients will be quick or taste right.
would_change_my_mind: If the free dishes actually got me cooking Thai on weeknights with stuff from my regular grocery store and I kept wanting more than 3 a month.
